grades.quote: Any level of PTE may be a leaf PTE, so in addition to pages, Sv48 supports _megapages_ , _gigapages_ , and _terapages_ , each of which must be virtually and physically aligned to a boundary equal to its size.
grades.reason: Provides useful larger-page and alignment rules, but explicitly describes Sv48 rather than Sv39.

grades.quote: A leaf PTE has been reached. If _i>0_ and _pte_ . _ppn_ [ _i_ -1:0] ≠ 0, this is a misaligned superpage; stop and raise a page-fault exception corresponding to the original access type.
grades.reason: Gives the higher-level leaf’s physical-alignment test, but does not explicitly describe Sv39 or its virtual-alignment requirement.
